summary: Owner dashboard test: 8 pages checked. 6 render with full content. 2 issues: (1) /owner/menu shows 'failed to load categories' error state despite API returning 200 with data — race condition in fetchCats before restaurantId propagates from auth/me. (2) /owner/categories does not exist as a route (404); category management is part of /owner/menu. All API calls return 200. No console errors on rendered pages. Browser navigation to loyalty/reviews/settings timed out in isolated context (missing session cookie) but curl confirms they return 200 with correct content. The Next.js dev overlay error about a script tag in layout.tsx (line 79) is a dev-only warning and does not affect production.
